channel.title: AI Daily News
channel.description: Daily curated AI news, 10 articles max. Curated, credible, traceable.

item.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
item.description: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

item.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
item.description: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

item.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
item.description: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

item.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
item.description: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

item.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
item.description: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.

item.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
item.description: Introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and tools to advance life sciences research.

item.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
item.description: Celebrate Teachers’ Day with AI for Educators in Brazilian Portuguese and see how Study Mode can help teachers support active, step-by-step learning.

item.title: Sullivan & Cromwell brings legal expertise into agreement review
item.description: In collaboration with OpenAI, Sullivan & Cromwell developed Agreement Analyzer, an AI tool for identifying issues in a draft agreement.

item.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
item.description: See how Amp pushes the frontier of what agents can do with GPT-6 Astra, Ultrafast, GPT-Live-1, and Sign in with ChatGPT.

item.title: SentinelOne cuts malware analysis from weeks to hours
item.description: With OpenAI Daybreak, SentinelOne cuts weeks of malware analysis to hours, creating capacity to investigate more threats.
